notes.title: Patch 1.04 Notes
notes.content:
Major bug fixes:


 Bypass for Open XR bug caused by Metas Quest Link v68 update
 Girafloat - Tutorial keys would disappear when going out of bounds
 Overrall optimization update
 Coco Bongo not resetting after being completed bug fixed


Minor bug fixes:

Aguita de Coco skinners not selectable on the Volara Radio when entering with Aguita de Coco until you switched to Plane 37

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.2.
notes.content:
Major bug fixes:


 MAJOR SPOILER ALERT: Bug fix: returning to Volara from credits fixed, no longer stuck and final star showcase happening
 Overall performance upgrade
 

Minor bug fixes:


 Upon the first time entering in Volara Tower, the album cover remained with question marks instead of switching to Volara Radio OST cover.
 Pausing and pressing exit in the credits would not unpause the game fixed
 Magmanimus clouds optimization update
 SPOILER ALERT: When unlocking Aguita de Cocos Magmanimus skin while having Coco Bongos' skin selected would not switch the cannons skin fixed

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.1
notes.content:
Major bug fixes:


 Girafloat capsule bug: Coming from First 
 Flight and crashing before entering Girafloat, the capsule would lock 
 itself until you went back to the title screen and came back.
 Coco Bobo and Coco Gogo achievements can now be unlocked.
 Parakeet Mangrove minor performance update, we're still working on making this level run as smoothly as possible for everyone.
 SPOILER ALERT: Parakeet Mangroves giant heads egg was not showing when the orange head was chosen
 SPOILER ALERT: Coming back from Topo Tron Hard Mode would lock your plane and not allow you to take off
 SPOILER ALERT: Parakeet Mangrove sixth egg puzzle modified so there's more clarity on which head the egg has spawned
 SPOILER ALERT: Added a clue for each of the eggs inside the cave under the waterfalls.


Minor bug fixes:


 Parakeets in the Mangrove were invisible, now you can see them
 Fixed minor visual glitches in Parakeet that showed grass flying
 Visual bug of the languages selection board being shown when you unlocked Aguita de Coco
 Visual fix: Light spheres in the main title no longer cast shadows
 Visual fix: Postcards wait a couple of seconds before growing in front of you.
 SPOILER ALERT: Coco Bongo Intro Room torches show you the stage you're  at. If you have reached one of the checkpoints, you will see them change color.

notes.title: KID PILOT is OUT NOW / Join our Discord
notes.content:
SOMETHINGS TO KNOW BEFORE YOU TAKE FLIGHT


Master of the Skies: 

Take control of your aircraft with simple hand gestures for multi-directional flight.

Continental Explorer: 
Earn achievement badges to unlock new maps and planes, expanding your world in Kid Pilot!

Rise to the Challenge: 
Adjust your flight pattern to pass through numerous obstacles, whether traversing a tiki maze or enjoying some target practice.

Flight Fun: 
Kid Pilot’s maps offer a range of challenges, increasing in difficulty as you master the game’s mechanics.

Fully Immersive: 
Taking advantage of VR’s 360° dimensions, let yourself fly into distant lands you could only dream of!
